purpose: Fresh 7B language-LoRA GRPO, learning rate 1e-5, seed 42, 1,000 optimizer steps; final checkpoint evaluated on the full fixed validation64 cohort.
reward: R_fmt + binary foreground IoU against full instance masks; no count, separation or topology reward.

optimizer_evidence.adapter_changed_steps_definition: Count of steps whose adapter differs from its initial weights; not a comparison against the preceding step.

resources.training_elapsed_definition: Training-loop elapsed, including periodic evaluations and checkpoint work; not the sum of optimizer-step durations.

data.selection: Official-30 MoNuSeg training sources, patient-disjoint train/validation partition; selected native 128x128 crops with 1-8 annotated nuclei. This run evaluates all 64 validation crops; benchmark8 is not pooled into a separate metric.

example_selection_rule: Lexicographically first ID with GT count exactly 1 and first with GT count >1; no output-based selection

evidence.raw_answers: before_records.jsonl and after_records.jsonl preserve all source completion records byte-for-byte.

conclusion: Final-checkpoint macro PQ rose from 0.0226549 to 0.0266846, while the total matched nuclei rose from 9 to 10 of 384. Count MAE and format validity worsened slightly. The model still misses most nuclei; this one-seed result does not establish robust improvement, superiority to another learning rate, or generalization.
limitations: The same 64 selected validation crops, drawn from four patients, are reused for monitoring and setting selection; they are not an untouched final test set.
This report uses the final 1,000-step checkpoint, not the best intermediate validation checkpoint. Nine periodic evaluations occurred during training.
One seed and a net increase of one matched nucleus do not establish robust improvement; most annotated nuclei remain unmatched.
The other learning-rate arm is not included; no learning-rate winner is claimed.
No pooling with benchmark8. Full-mask reward engineering; no weak-label, SOTA or clinical claim.
invalid_answer_handling: Two of 64 before answers and three of 64 after answers are rejected as whole responses. Their final masks are empty and remain in every evaluation denominator; exact unmodified emitted text is preserved in the JSONL records.
